explanation: A context-free, layer-0 token-identity detector: strength is a pure function of the current vocabulary piece (the same in any context; all input attribution sits on the peak token, 100% of the scan's variance is token identity, and moving the piece to another sentence leaves its value unchanged), and it fires on pieces of notation and formal terms of art rather than on running prose. Strongest are markup/punctuation runs (' ==' 0.69, ' ===' 0.52, '/*' 0.49, '<!--' 0.46, ':*' and '.*'), 3-digit numerals from roughly 133 to 183 (' 161' 0.93, ' 171' 0.86, ' 159' 0.84, ' 355' 0.67) but not single digits, spelled-out numbers or 4-digit years, Greek/LaTeX symbols (' pi' 0.66, ' σ' 0.61, '}|^'), software identifiers (' instanceof' 0.75, ' org' 0.54, ' validate' 0.51, ' install' 0.48, ' main' 0.46, 'build' without a leading space 0.78), and word-initial fragments of Latinate names (' Sa' 0.84, ' Cont' 0.81, ' Mat' 0.68, ' Af' 0.67 against ' Ba' 0.12, ' Pa' -0.04, ' Na' -0.17); a weaker middle band covers court-opinion terms of art (grounds 0.86, trial 0.83, denied 0.82, court 0.79, appeal 0.73, contest 0.67, exclude 0.64, judge 0.57, conviction 0.55, granted 0.55, warrants 0.51, claims 0.49, implied 0.48, affirmed 0.40) and generic technical-reporting nouns (among 0.66, study 0.48, claim 0.47, test 0.44, case 0.40, context 0.38, problem 0.36). It stays at or below zero on ordinary prose - everyday and conversational vocabulary, narrative verbs, medical, financial, sports, music, military and administrative words, formal connectives (therefore 0.00, thus -0.06, moreover -0.11), opaque Latinate abstractions (information -0.14, management -0.17, professional -0.15, approach -0.17) - and, decisively, on the rest of the legal lexicon (law 0.09, legal -0.12, plaintiff -0.02, defendant 0.01, counsel -0.17, statute -0.06, judgment 0.08, guilty 0.01), so the legal part is a specific court-opinion word list and not the legal topic; the class is graded, so pieces between roughly 0.15 and 0.30 of max (' no' 0.36, ' s' 0.34, ' ;' 0.32, ' evidence' 0.29) sit near the 0.25 x max active line and the boundary is soft there.
